read.thesis: Honda's Q1 record operating profit (JPY 530.7bn) was driven by FX and tariffs, not capacity discipline; China retail fell ~50% and EV-related supplier compensation remains unbooked, so the FY guidance raise carries open-ended losses.

triggers.label: China ICE/hybrid capacity cut to 700-plus k
triggers.quote: we had a capacity of a little less than 1.5 million cars. And then ICE and Hybrid, we now have 700-plus capacity today.

triggers.label: China retail units down ~50% YoY
triggers.quote: the retail unit is slightly more than 80,000. So it's about 50% less than last fiscal year first quarter.

triggers.label: FY OP guidance raised JPY 150bn to 650bn
triggers.quote: Operating profit has been revised upward by JPY 150 billion to JPY 650 billion.

triggers.label: EV supplier compensation not yet booked
triggers.quote: we cannot say at this point in time how much compensation will be required.

triggers.label: Raw material cost headwind JPY 313bn FY
triggers.quote: Price and cost impact will be negative by JPY 313 billion due to the impact of soaring material costs

guidance.quote: Operating profit has been revised upward by JPY 150 billion to JPY 650 billion.
Adjusted operating profit will be JPY 1.170 trillion, up by JPY 170 billion.
the profit for the year attributable to owners of the parent will be JPY 400 billion, up by JPY 140 billion.
EV-related losses have also been revised to reflect the updated currency assumptions.
annual dividends for FYE March 2027 will be no different from the previous guidance, keeping JPY 70 per share.
We will keep the unit sales of the group same as the previous forecast

red_flags.label: Unbooked EV supplier compensation
red_flags.quote: we cannot say at this point in time how much compensation will be required.

red_flags.label: Earthquake impact on unit sales unknown
red_flags.quote: To be very honest, we don't know how much impact it will have on our unit sales at this point in time.

evasions.quote: we don't know how much impact it will have on our unit sales at this point in time.
we cannot say at this point in time how much compensation will be required.
we cannot say that it will be necessary to source from alternative sources or not.
